desc: Massive containers hold spent nuclear fuel at safe and secure dry storage facilities. This photo shows, at right, dry cask recently loaded with spent fuel being lifted from a horizontal transporter to be placed vertically on a specially-designed storage pad. Courtesy of Sandia National Laboratories.
